mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Random Walk Index high/low line crossing identifies a newly dominant non-random directional range; follow the newly dominant line for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when RWI High crosses strictly above RWI Low; short when RWI Low crosses strictly above RWI High
mechanism.why_distinct: RWI compares current extreme-to-prior-extreme displacement across every horizon from one through fourteen with the corresponding one-bar-lagged average true range times square-root horizon, then selects each directional maximum. It is not raw momentum sums, regression, price-average crossover, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour crossings between independently maximized range-normalized directional lines are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.true_range: max(high-low,abs(high-previous close),abs(low-previous close)) on completed four-hour bars
features.atr_by_horizon: simple mean of the prior n completed true ranges, ending one bar before the current bar
features.rwi_high: maximum over n=1..14 of (current high-low n bars earlier)/(prior ATR(n)*sqrt(n))
features.rwi_low: maximum over n=1..14 of (high n bars earlier-current low)/(prior ATR(n)*sqrt(n))
features.event: strict sign crossing of RWI High minus RWI Low
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical RWI maximum period 14 high/low line crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no maximum/minimum period, ATR convention, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: for n=1..14, RWI High=(current high-low n bars earlier)/(ATR(n) computed one bar earlier*sqrt(n)); RWI Low=(high n bars earlier-current low)/(same denominator); each line is its maximum across n
external_basis.selection_use: published default maximum period 14 and directional high/low line dominance only; no incidence or outcomes
